description: This file implements an interrupt handling mechanism for a Go testing framework, managing OS signals and cross-process aborts, and providing status updates.

classes.name: InterruptStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of an interrupt, including its level and cause, and provides utility methods.

classes.name: InterruptHandler
classes.description: Handles OS signals and cross-process aborts, manages interrupt levels and causes, and provides status updates.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the InterruptCause.

methods.name: Interrupted
methods.description: Checks if the interrupt level indicates an interruption.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Returns a message describing the cause of the interrupt.

methods.name: ShouldIncludeProgressReport
methods.description: Determines if a progress report should be included based on the cause.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the interrupt handler by closing the stop channel.

methods.name: registerForInterrupts
methods.description: Registers for OS signals and cross-process aborts, updating interrupt status accordingly.
